name: zhihui-ai-canvas
description: 郅绘ai画布 - Windows desktop infinite canvas for AI ecommerce and advertising design.
author: Zhihui AI Canvas

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "vite build --config electron.vite.config.ts --watch" "vite build --config electron.preload.vite.config.ts --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 dist-electron/main.js dist-electron/preload.cjs && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config electron.vite.config.ts && vite build --config electron.preload.vite.config.ts && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win nsis --publish never --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.build:renderer: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config electron.vite.config.ts && vite build --config electron.preload.vite.config.ts
scripts.build:renderer:legacy: cross-env ZH_CANVAS_BILLING=disabled tsc --noEmit && cross-env ZH_CANVAS_BILLING=disabled vite build && cross-env ZH_CANVAS_BILLING=disabled vite build --config electron.vite.config.ts && cross-env ZH_CANVAS_BILLING=disabled vite build --config electron.preload.vite.config.ts
scripts.build:renderer:billing: cross-env ZH_CANVAS_BILLING=enabled tsc --noEmit && cross-env ZH_CANVAS_BILLING=enabled vite build && cross-env ZH_CANVAS_BILLING=enabled vite build --config electron.vite.config.ts && cross-env ZH_CANVAS_BILLING=enabled vite build --config electron.preload.vite.config.ts
scripts.build:recharge-generator: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win nsis --publish never --config electron.recharge-builder.json --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.build:canvas:0.1.23: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win nsis --publish never --config electron.canvas-0.1.23-builder.json --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.build:canvas:0.1.26: cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win nsis --publish never --config electron.canvas-0.1.26-builder.json --config.npmRebuild=false
